Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.select

Class SelectActionObject.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.select.SelectActionObject.Builder
Enclosing class:
SelectActionObject
public static class SelectActionObject.Builder extends Object
Builder class for constructing SelectActionObject instances.

This builder provides a fluent interface for setting the numerous configuration parameters needed for a select operation. All setter methods return the builder instance for method chaining.

Migration Note: The builder now supports both ActionConfig (legacy) and ActionConfig (modern) APIs. New code should use the ActionConfig setters.
